description: The authenticated Primitive account. managed_inbox_address is a domain, not a mailbox; sender_address (such as agent@pink-ram.primitive.email) is the mailbox sendEmail sends from by default. Result: id, email, plan, managed_inbox_address, created_at, limits, entitlements, onboarding_completed, and sender_address when there is a managed inbox.

api_key.description: API key from createEmailAddress, used in place of sign-in.

name: getAccount

outputSchema.description: The account: plan, limits and the mailbox to send from.

email.description: Owner email; null for a no-signup account.

send_per_day.description: Emails it may send per day.

send_per_hour.description: Emails it may send per hour.

managed_inbox_address.description: Managed inbox domain, not a mailbox; null if none.

onboarding_completed.description: True when setup is finished; null if unknown.

plan.description: Plan name, such as agent or developer.

sender_address.description: Mailbox to send from by default. Set when there is a managed inbox.

title: Get account
